The name Shaela carries the meaning “God's mountain goat” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Shaela usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mountain goat and live with faith, good character and purpose.
